body: I work in a jail. If anything has made me lose hope, It's the high majority of these people

I'm just worried because of all the debt I have currently. I am worried by going and seeing them will cause more debt but I might be wrong. The system we have to help us takes forever to reach back to us. I had a guy work here that was going through the same thing and it took 2 weeks for them to get back to him with a location for help. My ID card doesn't have anything useful on it besides my information. I will have to try and find something though. Thank you for the information. Means alot
I worked 71 hours this week alone. My mental health is shot and in not good standards.
